title: spring.config.import (vault)
description: The vault provider has no bound prefix; it is consumed via spring.config.import=optional:vault:<host>:<port>/<mount>/<path>?scheme=&namespace=&key=&format=&prefix=&kv-version=&poll-ms=&timeout-ms=&token=&token-file=

key.description: read one secret field holding a whole document; default read the whole secret

prefix.description: prefix applied to every key read from the secret

poll-ms.description: watcher poll interval in milliseconds; default 5000

token.description: Vault token; falls back to VAULT_TOKEN, then token-file / VAULT_TOKEN_FILE
